name: Asana
summary: Work management platform for teams: tasks, projects, goals, views, automation and AI teammates.
description: Asana is a work management platform where teams plan projects, tasks and goals, with list, board, calendar, timeline and Gantt views, workflow automation rules and forms, and AI teammates plus AI Studio for agent-driven workflows. Includes a free AI-workflow template gallery and 100+ app integrations.
contains: tasks, projects, goals and portfolios with list, board, calendar, timeline and Gantt views
pricing: free Personal plan (2 users), Starter $10.99/user/month billed annually, Advanced and Enterprise tiers
free AI-workflow template gallery browsable by team (marketing, operations, HR, design, product/engineering, sales)
AI Teammates, AI Studio no-code workflows and Asana Dash assistant
workflow automation with rules, forms and bundles
100+ integrations incl. Slack, Google Drive and Zoom
